text: String twenty seconds of extension onto take3 with the extend mod, and re-shoot take4 from a new camera — I want to SEE both commissions on the timeline, not guess what got armed.

Both arms are armed and drawn: the Extend commission shows its 3 chained windows of 158f (16.500s delivered) and its bound source clip, the Reshoot commission names take4 with the camera dials — a rail row per armed bag, above the lanes it affects.
